title: Nuclei Isolation from Mouse Lung for Single Nucleus RNASeq
author: Jeffrey Koenitzer
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdv2i68e
materials: Pre-cool all instruments (including centrifuges), buffers, and tubes. Note: All steps are performed On ice or in cold room ( 4 °C ) to minimize RNA degradation.

steps.title: Prepare and Lyse Lung Tissue
steps.instruction: Thaw the mouse lung sample on a small plastic weighing boat and inject lysis buffer to dissociate the tissue.

substeps.instruction: Remove mouse lung sample from -80 ºC freezer and trim a ~6 mm 3 piece.
Thaw on a small plastic weighing boat until a 26G needle can be inserted into the tissue.
Inject ice cold 1 mL Lysis Buffer to 'inflate' the tissue.
Add the remaining Lysis Buffer and chop into the smallest pieces possible using scissors (60 s).

steps.title: Mechanical Dissociation
steps.instruction: Process the minced tissue using a GentleMacs dissociator.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the minced tissue and buffer to a GentleMacs C tube.
Close, invert, and transfer directly to the MACS Tissue dissociator.
Run m_lung_01 program and m_lung_02 program in sequence, stopping the latter after 00:00:20.

steps.title: Clear Foam and Filter Lysate
steps.instruction: Remove foam from the suspension and filter the lysate to remove debris.

substeps.instruction: Reduce foam by centrifugation at 750 x g, 4 °C, for 1 minute.
Using a wide bore tip, pipette up and down to recover any pelleted material.
Pass lysate through a 40 µm filter into a 50 ml conical tube.

steps.title: Fine Filtration and Washing
steps.instruction: Perform a secondary filtration of the suspension.

substeps.instruction: Wash strainer with 4 mL Wash Buffer.
Pass suspension through a 5 µm strainer into a 50 ml conical tube.

steps.title: Nuclei Recovery and Concentration
steps.instruction: Concentrate the nuclei and resuspend them for counting.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 600 x g, 4 °C, for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Nuclei Counting and Dilution
steps.instruction: Quantify the nuclei and adjust to the target concentration.

substeps.instruction: Dilute to desired concentration (e.g. 10,000 per µl).
